name: vidpocket
description: A local-first Chrome webpage video downloader for directly accessible media resources and unencrypted HLS streams.

scripts.check: node --check src/background.js && node --check src/content.js && node --check src/popup.js && node --check helper/vidpocket-helper.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node tests/background-unit.mjs && node tests/popup-match-unit.mjs && node tests/hls-unit.mjs
